fix: The LayoutBuilder closure runs on every layout pass and clones the whole AppBar (including its Vec of actions) only to override the height. Instead, add a `toolbar_height_override: Option<f32>` parameter to the private `AppBar::build_with_theme` (highest precedence: `override.or(self.toolbar_height).or(inherited.toolbar_height).unwrap_or(K_TOOLBAR_HEIGHT).max(1.0)`), pass `None` from `build`/`From<AppBar>`, and in the closure call `app_bar.build_with_theme(&current_control_theme(context), None, incular_config::TargetPlatform::default(), Some(height))` with no clone. Keep the same platform/inherited arguments the closure passes today.

`child` (a full clone of the SliverAppBar) is unused in the snap-implied FloatingPinned branch (around line 578). Build it lazily only in the branches that use it, e.g. `Widget::from(self.clone())` inline in the pinned/non-pinned-floating/else arms, so that branch does not clone.

`bottom_region` is only moved at line ~839 under `if self.extend_body`, and cloned here only under `!self.extend_body`; the two are mutually exclusive. Move it into exactly one branch: `if self.extend_body { stack_children.push(...bottom_region...) } else { children.push(bottom_region.with_key("scaffold-bottom-region")) }`, dropping the `.clone()`.
